item.title: (SEEKING GREENLIGHTS) Questionable Infohazard
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Typical SCP article including logs of every asked question, their host's reactions, and outcomes.

+Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention Grabber, and Notes
- why?

Elevator Pitch: The anomaly is an infohazard that induces a great sense of curiosity to individuals who have gained any information regarding it. Individuals with knowledge of the SCP initially ask themselves a certain question, regardless of which it is unknown to the individual or not, or classified or not. The subjects have no control over whatever question they ask. That is known as Stage 1 of the "infection". Stage 2 makes the individual have a great urge in research, usually that of the question they asked themselves. In certain individuals, Stage 3 may manifest. Stage 3 is death by insanity, believed to have been caused by the exponential growth of their will to find information or their "ultimate answer" to their questions. Stage 3 is only known to manifest if ever an individual asks themselves a certain impossibility, or possibly classified information. The infohazard is only lethal whenever an individual expires after 3 years of infection.

Central Narrative: The infohazard was detected after a lack of personnel morale. Plenty of personnel was observed asking "why" to themselves, with the situation growing large enough to be taken into consideration by the O5 council. Journals were distributed to affected personnel in an attempt to learn the nature of the phenomenon. The journals contain the questions, reactions, and outcomes of the personnel.

Examples:

Dr. █████

Q: Why did ███████ cheat on me?
R: Disappointed
O: Has found answer after interrogating Dr. ███████

Janitor ██████████

Q: How did O5-12 even get to █████████?
R: Confused
O: Janitor ██████████ was detained and taken into custody, interviewed. O5-12 then administered Class A amnestics

Dr. ███

Q: Why did Wondertainment make the █████████████ product line?
R: Extreme confusion
O: Subject was unable to recieve an answer, thus requesting amnestics.

Dr. ███████████

Q: How did SCP-█████ go to that other narrative?
R: Confused, striken with anxiety
O: Detained, interrogated by O5-██, was administered Class B amnestics. O5-██ claims it as a good way to determine possible future SCP's

Hook/Attention Grabber: A very dangerous or beneficial infohazard, causes great curiosity among the infected. Causes you to question anything, everything.

Additional notes: I'd prefer this article to be a great motivation when it comes to philosophical ideals, and the act of always questioning. But why?
